description: Download an existing image through the tenant's hosted browser after an optional authenticated flow and store it as a document. Required: steps (same named actions as browser_run_flow, including at least one goto) and image with exactly one of url or selector. Secrets are resolved from the tenant vault exactly as for browser_run_flow. The bytes must have a recognised raster-image signature; an HTTP-200 login page is rejected before storage. Optional: stealth, title, entity/entity_id. Returns document_id; view it with get_document_link.

entity.description: Record type to file the image against; use with entity_id

image.description: Image to download: exactly one of url or selector

selector.description: CSS selector of the image element on the page

secrets.description: Name -> { provider, field } from the tenant vault.

stealth.description: Ask the browser to reduce automation signals (does not bypass CAPTCHAs)

steps.description: Browser actions as in browser_run_flow, including at least one goto

title.description: Title of the stored image document

name: browser_download_image
